meaning:
ταλαιπωρία, -ας, ἡ
(ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;]
1. hard work (Hippocr.).
2. hardship, suffering, distress: Rom.3:16 (LXX) pl., Jas.5:1 (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153).
(Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Destruction and misery are in their ways.
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
